mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.order_item_id, r.product_id, r.member_id, r.overall_rating, r.taste_rating, r.design_rating, r.service_rating, r.content, r.status, r.created_at, rr.content AS reply_content, rr.created_at AS reply_created_at FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN review_replies rr ON rr.review_id = r.id

SELECT r.id, r.member_id, r.product_id, p.name AS product_name, r.overall_rating, r.taste_rating, r.design_rating, r.service_rating, r.content, r.status, r.created_at, rr.content AS reply_content, rr.created_at AS reply_created_at FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id LEFT JOIN review_replies rr ON rr.review_id = r.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (order_item_id, product_id, member_id, overall_rating, taste_rating, design_rating, service_rating, content, status) VALUES (#{orderItemId}, #{productId}, #{memberId}, #{overallRating}, #{tasteRating}, #{designRating}, #{serviceRating}, #{content}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET overall_rating = #{overallRating}, taste_rating = #{tasteRating}, design_rating = #{designRating}, service_rating = #{serviceRating}, content = #{content} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_item_id, product_id, member_id, overall_rating, taste_rating, design_rating, service_rating, content, status, created_at, updated_at FROM reviews WHERE id = #{id}
